scope: New questions on the same four retained documents; no market baseline or generalization claim.

queries.query: List all three ownership rules in Rust, including what happens when the owner goes out of scope.
queries.manual_expectation: Owner exists, only one at a time, dropped when owner leaves scope; all three required.

queries.query: Quais são as três regras de ownership do Rust, incluindo o que acontece quando o dono sai do escopo?
queries.manual_expectation: Same three rules in Portuguese; no single rule may count as complete.

queries.query: Can multiple Python except handlers execute for one exception, and do they handle exceptions raised in other handlers of the same try statement?
queries.manual_expectation: At most one handler executes; it handles exceptions in corresponding try clause, not sibling handlers. Both requested parts required.

queries.query: Does a resolved JavaScript Promise necessarily mean it has fulfilled, or can it still be pending or rejected?
queries.manual_expectation: Resolved does not imply fulfilled; pending or rejected is possible.

queries.query: List the three states of a JavaScript Promise and give the annual licensing fee charged by Mozilla for using each state.
queries.manual_expectation: Partial answer is allowed only if explicitly marked partial; no fee invented and no complete answer.

queries.query: List the three Rust ownership rules and the exact date on which each rule was first adopted.
queries.manual_expectation: Partial sourced rules are allowed only if explicitly partial; adoption dates are not in retained evidence.
